  <title>Hydrography Polygons, Dane County (WI)</title>
  <abstract>This is a countywide hydrolographic dataset that provides a comprehensive 2,400 scale representation of the hydrologic features in Dane County.

The feature dataset provides a representation of the hydrologic polygon features across Dane County, Wisconsin. </abstract>
